What changed, and why

Target membership

Was

Extracted API files were absent; deleted cache source remained registered.

Now

Regenerated project includes all API extensions, response shapes, and the legacy cache replacement.

Wrapped privacy

Was

Historical or frozen cards could name currently hidden/inactive people.

Now

New and frozen identity cards honor current visibility while aggregate totals remain historical.

Secret lifecycle

Was

A pending response could reveal a password after background clearing.

Now

Clearing invalidates pending requests as well as revealed secrets.

Announcement recovery

Was

Dismissal decoded the wrong envelope.

Now

Successful top-level dismissal clears its retry state.

Search Gear

Was

Search lacked local authentication and omitted bulk families.

Now

Local authentication is required; both serialized and bulk rows are projected.

Scan routing

Was

A People scope concealed a scanned bulk family.

Now

A successful family scan selects Gear before publishing results.

Personal Home

Was

Personal API counts were described as team totals and team lanes could never populate.

Now

The summary, overdue/pickup queue and fixture data follow scope=ios-home; unreachable lanes are removed.

Blasts and comparison

Was

All six areas were rejected; a real 0% could appear as missing.

Now

Enum-sized bounds accept every area. Web/native labels preserve 0% versus nil, including VoiceOver.

Verification

  • Wisconsin build on iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27.0: passed.
  • Native tests: 251 passed; source/API contracts: 821 passed; broader backend cases: 135 passed.
  • Simulator UI: 7 passed (full required student walkthrough, accessibility-size selections, and all five review regression paths).
  • TypeScript, touched-file ESLint (111 files), build:app, generated project membership, docs/codemaps, and audit inventory (82/82): passed.
  • Independent backend and native reviews: no actionable regressions.
  • The ios:xcode:verify wrapper stops at 11 pre-existing drift hits (7 literal status tints, 2 gestures, 2 already-formatted area labels). Direct build and simulator tests above passed; wrapper is not green.

Things to know

  • All work is unstaged on codex/ios-review-fixes. Root product files and pending branches were preserved. No commit, push, deployment, migration execution, email, or distribution occurred.
  • Before/after sources combine the exact pending PR revisions in baseline-sources.json. Xcode membership was regenerated as a prerequisite to render the pre-fix app. Identical DEBUG fixture additions supply the rare empty-pool state to both binaries. Runtime image captures verify the installed binary hash in runtime-captures.json.
  • Fixture proof is separate from authenticated server/DB behavior, real Siri lock-screen policy, physical camera scans, APNs, and installed-device/distribution acceptance.
  • Existing Wrapped UIScreen.main deprecation warning remains.
  • After-only interaction captures: home.png, shared-password.png, bulk-scan.png and comparison.png. These demonstrate final states; only the license pair is a matched before/after.
